features.text: THERAPEUTIC HAND EXTENSION: Designed to treat moderate to severe contractures in the wrist, hand, and fingers.
HEAT-MOLDABLE INSERT: Custom-fitted thermoplastic support promotes effective stretching and realignment.
PALMAR ROLL SYSTEM: Includes two incrementally larger rolls for progressive MCP and PIP joint extension.
COLOR-CODED STRAPS: Simplify caregiver use and ensure proper application for consistent therapy.
GRADUAL STRETCH CONTROL: Enables gentle, progressive therapy that restores mobility over time.
FSA HSA ELIGIBLE: Use your Flexible Spending or Health Savings Account for this purchase.
PERFECT FIT GUARANTEE: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with our U.S.-based specialists.

indications: Radial or ulnar deviation of the hand
